diagnostics.message: [design/no-direct-radix-imports] "HoverCardPortal" No exact ui/v3 export is recorded for this primitive; check the catalog or ask design before replacing it. Docs: design-doctor/docs/rules/no-direct-radix-imports.md

[design/no-reinvented-components] "button" Use Button from @/components/ui/v3/button instead of raw <button>. Button offers variants (default, destructive, outline, outline-emboss, secondary, ghost, subtle, link), sizes (xs, sm, md, lg, icon-xs, icon-sm, icon) and asChild composition. This is not a safe drop-in replacement; check props, semantics and behavior, or ask design when no exact replacement fits. Docs: design-doctor/docs/rules/no-reinvented-components.md
